scoring_justification: Recomputing the full HSA+PTMD pipeline from raw artifacts is infeasible; we compare agent-reported probabilities and melting point to paper gold with tolerances (T0 fallback).

columns.Motif: string (one of Ih, Dh, fcc, twin, mix, amorphous)

outputs.description: CSV file containing the equilibrium motif probabilities at 300, 400, 500, 600, and 609 K.

schema.content: A single floating-point number representing the melting temperature in Kelvin.

outputs.description: Text file containing the computed melting point (peak of heat capacity curve).

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the CSV probabilities against digitized reference values from the paper's Fig. 1a and Fig. 3 with an absolute tolerance of 0.1. The melting point is compared to the paper-reported value (609 K) with a tolerance of 20 K. Full credit for all points within tolerance; reward scales with fraction of points within tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold motif probabilities and melting point for Cu90
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from Fig. 1a, Fig. 3, and Table I of the paper Settem et al. (arXiv:2308.07792)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted from the published article
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers, exactly matching the reference solver's hardcoded answer.
